name: Titans (Behrouz, Zhong, Mirrokni)
ontology_notes: Sequence-model memory, not a companion store. Three hyper-heads. Core is limited-window attention as short-term memory. Long-term memory is an MLP whose weights are updated at test time by surprise-gated gradient descent on associative key-value loss. Persistent memory is a set of learnable, data-independent tokens prepended to the sequence. Variants are MAC (memory as context), MAG (memory as gate), and MAL (memory as layer). No user bio, character autobiography, relationship state, lore, or OOC types.

ontology.evidence: Paper §4 names core, long-term neural memory, and persistent memory. Persistent memory is task-knowledge parameters (paper §3.3), not a companion identity file. No user vs character vs relationship tables.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Paper §3.1 writes by inner-loop gradient descent on ℓ=||M(k_t)-v_t||_2^2. Surprise S_t combines past surprise (momentum η_t) and momentary gradient. No user pin. No refusal of jokes or hypotheticals. Whatever is surprising is more memorable.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: Paper §3.1 retrieve is a frozen-weight forward pass y_t=M*(q_t). MAC concatenates retrieved long-term tokens with persistent tokens and the current segment, then attention decides whether history is needed (Figure 2, Figure 3).
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: Weight update overwrites the compressed state. Forget gate α_t in Eq. 13 can leave memory unchanged (α→0) or clear it (α→1). No typed fact invalidation. Contradictions are not stored as rows.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Time is sequence index and chunk index for parallel mini-batch GD (paper §3.2). No calendar validity windows or last-Tuesday queries.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: One sequence model's weights. No user_id, character store, or relationship object.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Retrieval is associative lookup plus attention over concatenated memory tokens. No trauma, kink, or spoiler skip.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Surprising tokens write into weights. No provenance or trust tags. A jailbreak that produces large gradients would be treated as memorable.
poisoning.label: inferred

forgetting.evidence: Paper §3.1 Forgetting Mechanism. Adaptive gate α_t ∈ [0,1] as weight decay on M_{t-1}. Authors state this generalizes forget gates in GLA, Mamba2, and related RNNs. Not a user forget-that command.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Inner-loop GD per token or chunk, then matmul/scan parallelization (paper §3.2). Training FLOPs theoretically O(N). Deeper MLP memory (L_M=1..4) raises perplexity quality and changes throughput (Figures 7-8). No companion-prompt token budget because there is no companion prompt.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: arXiv HTML and Google Research pub page ship no official GitHub. Paper license is CC BY 4.0 on the PDF, not a software LICENSE. Unofficial clones exist (lucidrains/titans-pytorch) and are not the paper's code.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Architecture paper. No MCP server mentioned in https://arxiv.org/html/2501.00663.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Test-time neural memory for sequence models. Writes into weights, not a product memory API. No user vs character vs relationship types, no silence, no forget-that. Steal cost_shape and forget-as-capacity-management. Evals are LM, commonsense, NIAH, BABILong, genomics, and time series. Those are not companion holes.

published_eval.name: Language modeling and commonsense (WikiText, LAMBADA, PIQA, HellaSwag, WinoGrande, ARC-e/c, SIQA, BoolQ), RULER S-NIAH, BABILong, GenomicsBenchmarks, long-term forecasting
published_eval.claimed_score: Titans MAC 760M Wiki PPL 19.93, avg commonsense 52.51 (Table 1). S-NIAH-PK/N/W near 99 at short lengths (Table 2). MAC beats GPT-4 on BABILong in the paper's fine-tune plot (Figure 6). Scales past 2M context.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Next-token perplexity, commonsense accuracy, needle retrieval, and multi-hop facts in long documents. Not companion identity drift, social silence, poisoning, or user forget-that.

open_unknowns: Whether Google will release official Titans training code.
How closely unofficial pytorch clones match Eq. 13-15.
